capabilities: Merge the whole note or the current selection into a chosen target note
Open and focus the target note with the cursor at the merged content
Strip source frontmatter and optionally trash the source file after a whole-note merge
Redirect wikilinks and embeds pointing to the source note to the target
Rank target candidates by name match, similarity, recency, aliases, and optional AI suggestion
extras: README is mostly Chinese with an English brief section; the optional AI recommendation is off by default, 100% offline otherwise, and when enabled sends the note title, a 600-character body summary, and up to 30 BM25-screened candidate titles to the TypeSafe API. Installable via BRAT or manual download.
intentEvidence: Obsidian 自带的 Note Composer（笔记合并器）功能很实用
motivation: The author built it to fix the workflow breaks in Obsidian's merge flow: losing focus, whole-note-only granularity, frontmatter pollution, and hard-to-find targets in large vaults.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Note Composer leaves you on the source note after a merge, requires moving whole files, pastes in source frontmatter, and forces manual searching for the target note.

relations.evidence: 内置新一代 TypeSafe AI 的 Jev (System One) 快速直觉模型

summary: Merges the current note or selected text into another note and immediately opens the target, placing the cursor at the merged content.
